mainEntity.name: Does Jobber have door knocking or canvassing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Jobber is built for booked, inbound service work. Knockio includes canvassing, territory assignment, and live rep tracking in the same platform as job management.

mainEntity.name: Is Knockio cheaper than Jobber?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on team size. Jobber runs $49 to $499 per month by tier with extra users at $29 each, as of July 2026. Knockio is a flat $20 to $60 per user per month with everything included. Compare on your real user count.

mainEntity.name: Does Jobber integrate with QuickBooks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, QuickBooks Online sync is one of its stronger points, though some users report fixing sync errors by hand.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for a roofing or exterior sales company?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you sell at the door and manage production, Knockio fits that motion. Jobber suits recurring residential trades like lawn care and cleaning.

@graph.name: Knockio vs SPOTIO (2026): Field Sales Tool vs the Whole Job

mainEntity.name: What is the main difference between Knockio and SPOTIO?

acceptedAnswer.text: SPOTIO is a field sales specialist that ends at the sale. Knockio covers canvassing and then the whole job that follows, including scheduling, field updates, and invoicing.

mainEntity.name: Does SPOTIO handle invoicing or scheduling?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Those need a separate platform. Knockio includes them.

mainEntity.name: How much does SPOTIO cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: SPOTIO does not publish prices. Plans are quote only with a five user minimum, as of July 2026. Knockio publishes $20 to $60 per user per month.

mainEntity.name: Do I still need a CRM with SPOTIO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often yes. SPOTIO is frequently layered on Salesforce or HubSpot. Knockio is built to be the system of record itself.

mainEntity.name: What is Knockio route mapping?

mainEntity.name: How does Knockio help field teams save time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Knockio helps field teams save time by keeping routes, customer details, lead records, and job updates in one place. Reps and crews do not need to jump between maps, spreadsheets, notes, and CRM tools. They can see where to go and update work from the field.

mainEntity.name: Can managers track route progress in Knockio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Managers can view route activity, stop status, field updates, and rep progress inside Knockio. This helps them understand which stops were completed, which leads need follow-up, and where the team is working during the day without constant check-in calls.

mainEntity.name: Can routes connect with leads and customers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Routes can connect with lead and customer records inside Knockio. A rep can visit a stop, add notes, update status, upload photos, and set the next action. That information stays linked to the customer record for future sales or service work.

mainEntity.name: Is Knockio routes useful for both sales and service teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Sales teams can use routes for canvassing, lead visits, follow-ups, and local outreach. Service teams can use routes for job visits, inspections, repeat service, crew movement, and customer updates. Knockio keeps route work connected with the full field service CRM.
